evidence.why: Strict comparison, multiplication, and ordered downstream operations.

facts.rationale: Replace an unsupported magnitude guarantee with the exact configured operation and boundary.
facts.value: Provides a shared grounded shooting-item physics adapter. It forwards the fighter object to ft_80084F3C, which starts with character ground_friction, multiplies it by friction_when_above_walk_speed only when ABS(gr_vel) > walk_max_vel, then applies ground friction and ground movement. Equality skips scaling; the source does not establish that the configured multiplier necessarily strengthens friction.

evidence.why: Configured scaling rather than guaranteed strengthening.

facts.rationale: Preserve demonstrated gameplay reuse while removing an unproved greater-than-one assumption.
facts.value: Supplies common grounded friction and movement processing during held shooting-item states, including canonical L-Gun, Fire Flower, and Scope Start physics callbacks. Friction is character-specific and conditionally multiplied by common data above the walking-speed threshold; stronger deceleration is not guaranteed without the multiplier's value.

evidence.why: Complete joint, vector, and scalar flow.

facts.rationale: Replace the unconditional uniform-scale/cancellation claim with the exact implemented transform.
facts.value: Transforms a caller-provided point through the fighter joint selected by parts[ft_data->x8->x10].joint. It copies the point, multiplies all components by 1.0f/x34_scale.y when that scalar is not exactly 1.0f, and writes the affine matrix result to the output. Shooting-item callers use this as an emission/effect-position conversion. Only reciprocal-Y compensation is proved; cancellation of arbitrary nonuniform model scale is not.

facts.rationale: Include the additional Scope consumer and qualify scale cancellation.
facts.value: Computes fighter-joint-relative firing and effect positions for L-Gun, Fire Flower, and Scope callers from item-provided offsets. Reciprocal-Y scaling precedes the joint matrix and can compensate a corresponding uniform scale factor, but the helper does not prove or enforce that matrix-scale invariant.

evidence.why: Assertion and matrix setup before returning the matrix.

facts.rationale: Document boundaries, aliasing, borrowed inputs, and the distinction between Fighter reads and joint setup side effects.
facts.value: Uses an exact scale != 1.0f test and has no local zero, finite-value, pointer-chain, or joint-index validation. All three copied components use the Y-scale reciprocal. Input and output may be the same valid Vec3 because the input is copied before output writes. The helper retains no vector pointers and transfers no ownership; joint matrix setup may update joint state. Exceptional scales have no fallback, and exact target floating-point exception behavior remains unverified.

facts.rationale: Make invocation semantics and the optional consumer guard explicit without promising universal per-frame completion.
facts.value: On each invocation, queries ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining and calls ftCommon_8007D92C only if it returns false; the callee selects Fall for GA_Air and ft_8008A2BC otherwise. There is no local timer, item guard, or one-shot latch. Fire Flower's caller invokes this helper only while item_gobj is non-null, whereas both L-Gun Anim callbacks invoke it directly.
